newsitem.title: CANADA: Philip Environmental to buy Reclaimers.
newsitem.headline: Philip Environmental to buy Reclaimers.

text.p: Philip Environmental Inc said on Thursday that it has reached an agreement in principle to purchase Reclaimers Inc, a unit of U.S.-based Group Dekko Inc.
The value of the deal was not disclosed.
Reclaimers operates three wire and cable chopping lines from its plant in Indiana. The company generates annual revenues of US$23 million.
Philip also announced that it is calling for the redemption on October 15 of all of its outstanding six percent convertible subordinated debentures.
Philip said US$120 million of the debentures were issued in December 1993.
Each US$1,000 principal amount of debentures is convertible into 160 common shares of Philip at any time up to and including the close of business on October 15.
Philip also said that its unit, Taro Aggregates Ltd received approval from the Ontario government for a landfill located at its east quarry site in Stoney Creek, Ontario.
